candidates.titulo: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
candidates.resumen: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

candidates.titulo: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
candidates.resumen:
Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
candidates.resumen: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

candidates.titulo: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
candidates.resumen: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

candidates.titulo: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
candidates.resumen:
Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica.
